https://github.com/pmarreck/table
It has implementations in Rust, Zig, Roc, and Luajit. So far, I like it.

If you want to lift markdown parsing into Roc (if it's not already there), then https://github.com/showell/roc-markdown/blob/main/package/MdTable.roc may be useful.
